style_prompt: Editorial-quality flowchart diagram, hand-drawn line work on warm off-white paper background (#F7F4ED). Two-tone palette of deep Alberta navy (#1A3A6E) for primary nodes and rust orange (#C2491A) for accents and arrows. Boxes have subtle shadows; labels in clean sans-serif; arrows are slightly curved with arrowheads. Architectural, calm, technical but human. Wide editorial aspect. No photo realism, no people, no logos, no watermarks. All text labels in English.
image_prompt: An editorial illustration, green-accented, of a meticulous inspector going part by part over the inner workings of a machine or engine, ticking items on a clipboard checklist and pulling out one faulty bolt and one exposed key. A sense of patient, exact, repeatable code hygiene. Muted Alberta cream base with a clear green accent, archival print quality, no text. This must be related to software development, the engine an analogy to the software. No legend. All text labels in es. Match the composition of the source image exactly; only the text labels change.
